content.title: Canada 2026 Tour  | Bryan Adams
content.text: Bryan Adams Sign up for updates VIP Packages Shows Music News Shop Contact Bad Records Bryan Adams Photography © Bryan Adams 2026 Canada 2026 Tour Bryan has announced a new run of Canadian tour dates in support of ‘Roll With The Punches’, bringing his signature high-energy live show to arenas and amphitheatres nationwide beginning August 24th 2026.Joining Adams as special guest in all markets (except Thunder Bay**) is Lights, whose genre-blurring pop sound and electrifying stage presence make for a powerful opening set.Special VIP packages will also be available for fans looking to get right up close to the action. Perks include best-in-house tickets, access to a pre-show Q&A with Bryan Adams, exclusive behind-the-scenes production tour, autographed VIP pressing of the vinyl, and more. For more info visit superfan.live/bryanadams** Thunder Bay is a Bare Bones acoustic show. © Bryan Adams 2026 Mailing List Privacy Policy Terms & Conditions Contact Merchandise Contact This site uses functional cookies and external scripts to improve your experience.
